correctness.rationale: Exact center coordinates determine all 36 circle intersections. Green boundary integration reduces to three symmetry representatives with 12 strictly ordered events each. Their signed endpoint integrals simplify to the claimed inverse-trigonometric identity. A standard-library interval checker constructs all strict event comparisons and proves -0.033502 < area-pi < -0.033500 with exact fractions. Independent polar quadrature confirms the approximate value; the perturbation bound follows from disk symmetric-difference slicing and uses the strict rational margin.

value.rationale: The result provides a motivated exact natural invariant of the canonical seven-disk obstruction to a longstanding odd-area inequality. Unlike an isolated numerical recomputation, it supplies a transparent finite arc-order proof, exact rigorous inequality margin and an explicit open neighborhood of further counterexamples, making the benchmark reproducible for future odd-area optimization. It does not claim a global minimum or downstream theorem.
